title: Fractional Volterra-type operators from Bergman spaces with two-sided doubling weights to Hardy spaces
summary: For \(ω\in\calD\), we give necessary and sufficient symbol conditions for the boundedness and compactness of the Riemann--Liouville family\(V^\varphi_{α,β}:A^p_ω\to H^q\) for every \(0 0\): without any additional weight assumption when \(α\geβ\), and, when \(α<β\), under the condition \(p(β-α)<d_-(ω)\), where \(d_-(ω)\) is the critical reverse-doubling exponent. We prove that this inequality is exactly equivalent to the naturally shifted source weight retaining the two-sided doubling and tail geometry required by the reduction; an integrable logarithmic example shows that the endpoint fails.…
